testResults.name: alpaca-sip-websocket
testResults.result: 5 tests passed for subscription, exact normalization, reception, disconnect recovery, bounded backoff, stale-symbol detection, timestamp sanity, and atomic inbox rejection.

testResults.name: replay-schema-parity
testResults.result: Normalized quote and trade events round-trip through the same core Parquet schemas used by replay.

testResults.name: focused-quality
testResults.result: Focused Ruff lint, Ruff format, and ty checks passed; network and clock behavior are injected at the async shell boundary.

decisions: No concrete WebSocket dependency is added; production runtime must inject an AsyncWebSocketTransport.
The synchronous inbox owns deterministic event IDs and sequences and performs no network or wall-clock access.
limitations: Tests use injected mock transports; no live WebSocket connection was required.
